title: The gBCE loss as a drop-in replacement for SASRec's BCE
notes: Self-contained: imports torch.nn.functional itself and defines gbce_loss, so exec PASSES. SIGNATURE DRIFT vs package: book prints gbce_loss(pos_scores, neg_scores, num_items, t=0.75) with NO pos_mask and averages (pos_loss+neg_loss).mean()/(n_neg+1) over ALL positions. Package is gbce_loss(pos_scores, neg_scores, pos_mask, num_items, t=0.75) and averages only over pos_mask=True positions. The book is internally inconsistent: its own Listing 6.5 calls gbce_loss(pos_scores, neg_scores, cloze_mask, num_items) (4 positional args = package signature). Feeding the 6.5 call into the 6.3 def raises RuntimeError (bool tensor subtraction), verified.
